name: Rephidim
line: Rephidim was a camp in the wilderness where Israel found no water, fought the Amalekites, and then left to go on to the Wilderness of Sinai.

moments.title: No water to drink
moments.text: Israel camped at Rephidim, but there was no water. The people argued with Moses, and God told him to strike the rock at Horeb so water would come out for them.

moments.title: The Amalekites attack
moments.text: The Amalekites attacked Israel at Rephidim. Israel prevailed while Moses held up his hands, and Aaron and Hur held them steady until sunset, so Joshua overwhelmed Amalek with the sword.

moments.title: Leaving for Sinai
moments.text: After Israel set out from Rephidim, they entered the Wilderness of Sinai and camped in front of the mountain.
